title: Lumière Oval Solitaire Pendant
tagline: One oval, turned on its side.
body: A single oval cut clear cubic zirconia, about 11mm by 9mm, is set east to west in four slim gold claws, so it sits wider than it is tall. A small jump ring hangs it from a smooth, rounded bail on a twisted rope chain about 2mm thick. Part of the Lumière line of oval cut pieces.
tip: Wear it with the Lumière Oval Solitaire Studs, or with the Lumière Oval Solitaire Ring.
details: Pendant: Approximately 17mm long, from the top of the bail
Stone: Oval cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 11mm by 9mm, set east to west

title: Marquise Solitaire Studs
tagline: One long marquise, point to point.
body: Each stud is a single marquise cut clear cubic zirconia, about 13mm long and 7mm wide, held upright in four slim gold claws that leave both points bare. Long enough to catch the eye, light enough for every day.
tip: Wear them with your hair tucked back, or beside a small hoop in a second piercing.
details: Stone: Marquise cut clear cubic zirconia
Setting: Four slim gold claws, the points left bare
images: the pair on a cream plaster block

title: Petite Pear Solitaire Studs
body: Each stud is one pear cut clear cubic zirconia, about 8mm by 6mm, held point up in three fine gold claws: one at the tip and two around the curve. Small and clean, made for every day.
tip: Wear them with the Petite Pear Solitaire Necklace, or with the Petite Pear Solitaire Ring.
details: Stone: Pear cut clear cubic zirconia, worn point up
images: the pair on a cream plaster block

title: Pear Baguette Duet Studs
tagline: A pear and a baguette, side by side.
body: Each stud pairs one pear cut clear cubic zirconia, about 10mm by 6.5mm, with a slim baguette of about 9mm by 4.5mm, each in its own fine gold claws. The pear sits a little higher than the baguette, and the two studs are mirror images, so the baguettes sit on the outside. About 12mm across.
tip: Let them be the only earrings you wear; they do the work of a statement earring at stud size.
details: Pear: Pear cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 10mm by 6.5mm
Baguette: Baguette cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 9mm by 4.5mm
Pair: Mirror images, the baguettes on the outside
images: the pair on a cream plaster block

title: Heart Solitaire Drop Studs
tagline: A gold heart, and a stone that swings below it.
body: Each earring is a small puffed heart in polished gold tone, about 7.5mm across, worn as a stud, with one round clear cubic zirconia of about 6mm hanging from a tiny jump ring at its point. About 17.5mm long, the stone moves as you do.
tip: Wear them on their own every day, or with the Heart Solitaire Huggies in a second piercing.
details: Heart: Puffed and polished, approximately 7.5mm across
Stone: Round clear cubic zirconia, approximately 6mm, in four fine gold claws
images: the pair on a cream plaster block

title: Petite Pear Solitaire Ring
tagline: One pear, pointing to the fingertip.
body: A single pear cut clear cubic zirconia, about 9mm by 6mm, is held in fine gold claws and laid along the finger on a slim polished band about 1.5mm wide. The band is open at the back, so it adjusts to fit US 5 to 9.
tip: Wear it with the Petite Pear Solitaire Studs, or with the Petite Pear Solitaire Necklace.
details: Stone: Pear cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 9mm by 6mm
Band: Plain polished, approximately 1.5mm, open at the back

body: Each stud is a single oval cut clear cubic zirconia, about 9mm by 7mm, standing upright in four slim gold claws. Part of the Lumière line of oval cut pieces.
tip: Wear them with the Lumière Oval Solitaire Pendant, or with the Lumière Oval Solitaire Ring.
details: Stone: Oval cut clear cubic zirconia
